description: Use when an agent needs to know which Hyperliquid perps moved unusually. Returns each coin whose 5-minute, 1-hour or 4-hour price move, or 1-hour open-interest change, is past its own measured tail (tiers from the coin's own history, sample size printed), labelled event-driven when a scheduled FOMC, CPI, NFP or PCE release explains it. An empty list is a valid answer. Stale inputs answer 503, never billed. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
